initial_capture.script:
extends RefCounted
func execute(tree: SceneTree) -> Variant:
	var main: Node = tree.get_meta("actor_main")
	var vp := SubViewport.new()
	vp.size = Vector2i(480,640)
	vp.own_world_3d = true
	vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ALWAYS
	tree.root.add_child(vp)
	main._story_human.reparent(vp)
	var env := WorldEnvironment.new()
	env.environment = Environment.new()
	env.environment.background_mode = Environment.BG_COLOR
	env.environment.background_color = Color(.09,.105,.12)
	env.environment.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_COLOR
	env.environment.ambient_light_color = Color(.8,.86,1)
	env.environment.ambient_light_energy = .7
	vp.add_child(env)
	var light := DirectionalLight3D.new()
	light.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-35,-35,0)
	light.light_energy = 1.4
	vp.add_child(light)
	var camera := Camera3D.new()
	vp.add_child(camera)
	camera.current = true
	camera.fov = 38
	main._native.debug_restart_at(Vector3(-94,1.2,-44))
	for i in 110:
		main._native.advance_frame(1.0/90.0)
		main._ctx = main._read_context()
		main._update_story_human(main._native.get_tick_index())
	var actor: Dictionary = main._native.get_story_actor_state()
	camera.global_position = actor.position + Vector3(.7,.25,3.0)
	camera.look_at(actor.position-Vector3(0,.05,0))
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	var path := "/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/tmp/scraperx-portable-line-20261020/character-prototype/human-native-gait.png"
	var error := vp.get_texture().get_image().save_png(path)
	tree.set_meta("gait_vp",vp)
	return {"capture":path,"save_error":error,"native_supported":actor.supported,"native_velocity":actor.velocity,"gait_weight":main._story_human._gait._weight,"gait_phase":main._story_human._gait._phase,"gait_error":main._story_human._gait.last_error}
